text:
Sam (Release): Heads-up: RC1 sanity pass today. Please do a quick version bump, changelog touch, and a CI green sweep before 6pm PT. Aim to cut RC1 by EOD. Main checklist: bump version, regen changelog, run smoke suite, triage flakes, tag branch.

Maria (Eng): On it. Which branch — main or release/2.4? I have the bump patch ready.

Sam (Release): Release branch is release/2.4. @Maria please land bump to 2.4.0-rc1 on release/2.4 and open a PR to main with the changelog. PR title: chore(release): 2.4.0-rc1.

Maria (Eng): Will do, pushing in a min. Command I'm running: `git checkout release/2.4 && ./scripts/bump_version.sh 2.4.0-rc1 && git push`

ci-bot: ci-bot: build queued for commit abc123 on release/2.4 — jobs: smoketest, unit, integration. Link: https://ci/internal/abc123

Kevin (SRE): I'll watch the pipeline and reroute capacity if we see queueing or GPU contention. If CI workers spike, ping me. Also, avoid heavy e2e on the branch between 5-6pm PT.

Jen (QA): Running smoke suite now. Noted flaky tests from last week: `tests/integration/test_db.py::test_conn_timeout` and `tests/ui/test_login.py::test_login_fails_then_succeeds`. I'll pin those to flaky-quarantine if they show up.

Sam (Release): If you quarantine, add an issue and link the PR. Our quarantine convention: add `@pytest.mark.flaky_quarantine(reason=..., created_by=...)`. Example: `@pytest.mark.flaky_quarantine(reason="db timeouts on CI", created_by="jen")`

Maria (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4567 — bump + changelog. CI shows one flaky integration failure (db timeout). Jen, can you triage and add the quarantine marker?

Jen (QA): Reproduced locally with `pytest tests/integration/test_db.py::test_conn_timeout -q` — intermittent. Filing #789 and will add the marker + update changelog note, then re-run.

ci-bot: ci-bot: rerun for PR #4567 triggered by @jen — build success: smoketest & unit passed; integration flaky pinned. :tada:

Kevin (SRE): :thumbsup: If anything infra-related pops, I'll escalate. Quick reminder to update the release notes in the tracker before cut.

Sam (Release): Final ask: who's on watch for the cut window 6-7pm PT? @Kevin you're on infra watch, @Maria will handle the merge, I'll do the tag. If green by 5:50pm we'll cut.

Maria (Eng): Calendar looks clear — I'll merge at ~5:55pm PT if green.

Jen (QA): I'll run a final smoke at 5:52pm and post results here.

Sam (Release): Thanks team. I'll post a final status update here when the tag is pushed. :shipit:

ci-bot: ci-bot: tag `2.4.0-rc1` created at commit abc456 — artifacts uploaded to staging. See https://ci/internal/artifacts/abc456

Sam (Release): Cutting complete, thanks everyone.
